name: FSL FIRST
purpose: Model-based segmentation/registration for automatic segmentation of a number of subcortical structures, producing mesh and volumetric outputs.

inputs.statement: FIRST needs a good quality T1-weighted image.
inputs.quote: FIRST needs a good quality T1-weighted image

inputs.statement: Only T1-weighted images can be used as input to run_first_all.
inputs.quote:
run_first_all -i t1_image -o output_name

The argument -i specifies the original T1-weighted structural image (only T1-weighted images can be used).

inputs.statement: first_flirt should be used on whole-head (non-betted) images.
inputs.quote: first_flirt should be used on whole-head (non-betted) images

conditions.statement: If the registration stage fails then the model fitting will not work, though run_first_all continues to run and may produce outputs.
conditions.quote:
if the registration stage fails then the models fitting will
not work, despite the fact that run_first_all continues to run and may produce outputs.

conditions.statement: When fitting the cerebellum models, a different transformation matrix than that used for the other structures must be input.
conditions.quote: When fitting the cerebellum models, you will need to input a different transformation matrix than that used for the other structures.

conditions.statement: The -cort flag must be specified for first_flirt to perform the registration needed for cerebellum models.
conditions.quote: cerebellum models, you will need to input a different transformation matrix than that used for the other structures. first_flirt will not perform the necessary registration by default - the -cort flag must be specified.

conditions.statement: The full path name to the model must be used with -m.
conditions.quote: -m: The model file (e.g. ${FSLDIR}/data/first/models_336_bin/L_Hipp_bin.bmv). The full path name to the model must be used.

steps.statement: Run run_first_all with -i specifying the T1-weighted image and -o the output basename.
run_first_all runs lower-level utilities including first_flirt, run_first and first on all structures with tuned settings.
steps.quote: This script will run lower-level utilities (including first_flirt, run_first and first) on all the structures, with the settings (number of modes and boundary correction) tuned to be optimal for each structure.

steps.statement: first_flirt runs two-stage affine registration to MNI152 space at 1mm resolution.
steps.quote: The first_flirt script runs two-stage affine registration to MNI152 space at 1mm resolution

steps.statement: The run_first script runs FIRST to extract a single structure.
steps.quote: The run_first script will run FIRST to extract a single structure

steps.statement: The final stage of run_first_all ensures there is no overlap between structures in the 3D image.
steps.quote: The final stage of the script ensures that there is no overlap between structures

checks.statement: Check the log directory error outputs; no output means no errors.
checks.quote:
cat *.logs/*.e*

and if there are no errors then you will see no output, otherwise you will see what errors have occured.

checks.statement: Check registration quality using slicesdir on the registered images.
Pay particular attention to the sub-cortical structures when assessing registrations.
checks.quote: pay particular attention to the sub-cortical structures

checks.statement: Check segmentation quality with first_roi_slicesdir, which generates a webpage summary.
checks.quote: first_roi_slicesdir is a script to generate summary images, in a webpage format, for the segmentation outputs

exceptions.statement: If there are problems, different segmentation options such as number of modes or boundary correction method can be tried using the individual tools.
exceptions.quote: If there are any problems, you can try different segmentation options (e.g. number of modes, boundary correction method, etc.) using the individual tools described in the Advanced Usage section.

exceptions.statement: Boundary correction method none is appropriate for models in the 05mm subdirectory.
exceptions.quote: For the models contained in ${FSLDIR}/data/first/models_336_bin/05mm/, all boundary voxels are considered as belonging to the structure, and hence none is the appropriate correction method.

outputs.statement: output_name_all_fast_firstseg.nii.gz is a single image showing the segmented output for all structures.
outputs.quote: output_name_all_fast_firstseg.nii.gz: This is a single image showing the segmented output for all structures

outputs.statement: output_name_all_fast_origsegs.nii.gz is a 4D image of individual segmentations without boundary correction.
outputs.quote: output_name_all_fast_origsegs.nii.gz: This is a 4D image containing the individual structure segmentations, converted directly from the native mesh representation and without any boundary correction.

outputs.statement: output_name_first.vtk is the mesh representation of the final segmentation.
outputs.quote: output_name_first.vtk : This is the mesh representation of the final segmentation

outputs.statement: output_name_first.bvars contains the mode parameters and the model used and should not be deleted.
outputs.quote: output_name_first.bvars: Do not delete this file. It contains the mode parameters and the model used

parameters.statement: The -m option specifies the boundary correction method and defaults to auto.
parameters.quote: -m specifies the boundary correction method. The default is auto

parameters.statement: The -s option allows a restricted set of structures to be selected, comma separated with no spaces.
parameters.quote: -s allows a restricted set of structures (one or more) to be selected. For more than one structure the list must be comma separated with no spaces.

parameters.statement: The -b option specifies that the input image is brain extracted, important when calculating the registration.
parameters.quote: -b specifies that the input image is brain extracted - important when calculating the registration.

parameters.statement: The -n option sets the number of modes of variation; more modes capture finer details but may reduce robustness.
parameters.quote: -n: The number of modes of variation to be used in the fitting. The more modes of variation used the finer details FIRST may capture, however you may decrease the robustness/reliability of the results.
